title: staged-egress-nat-allocator-and-conditional-dns-delegation-rollback
author: Ethan Park
description: Motivation: customer on-prem control planes need deterministic AZ-aware egress NAT allocation and an auditable, reversible handoff of Route53 private delegation for cross-account resolver setups. This PR introduces a Terraform module and installer hooks to provision a staged egress NAT allocator with zone affinity, ephemeral ENI support for control plane endpoints, and a conditional DNS delegation workflow that can be rolled back safely. Summary of changes: 1) terraform/modules/egress-nat-allocator: new module that computes AZ affinity, allocates NAT Gateways or ENI-based NAT proxies based on deployment flavor, and exposes a staged allocation plan for rollback. 2) terraform/modules/controlplane-subnet: add tags and ownership metadata to enable deterministic subnet selection by allocator. 3) installer/hooks/preflight and installer/hooks/post-rollout: add scripted handoff steps to create cross-account Route53 delegation records, sign delegation tokens, and optionally register fallback resolver rules. 4) helm/redwood-private/templates/daemonset-egress-proxy.yaml: add annotations for ephemeral-eni lifecycle hooks. 5) tooling/rollback/rollback-manager: add a lightweight Terraform wrapper that can revert staged NAT assignments and revoke delegation tokens in a controlled order. Checklist: [x] module implemented and unit-tested, [x] helm changes linted, [x] integration tests for staged rollout and rollback, [x] migration plan documented in release_notes. Migration notes: new TF state resources introduce a staged "allocation_plan" remote state key; operators must run `terraform apply -var=apply_stage=true` to commit the staged allocation. By default the installer runs in "staged" mode to allow verification before commit. Rollback instructions: use tooling/rollback/rollback-manager rollback --plan-id=<id> which will reverse ENI attachments, release allocated NAT IPs back to the pool, and remove delegation tokens while keeping controlplane subnets intact. Testing: ran full CI (terraform fmt, terraform validate, helm lint, unit tests) and a canary deployment in lab region eu-west-1. Observability: added metrics for allocation latency and delegation propagation in prometheus/metrics.yaml. Security: delegation tokens are KMS-encrypted and rotated on rollback. Performance: expected ~2x faster failover when using AZ-affine ENI proxies vs cold NAT Gateway recreation in multi-AZ failover scenarios. Related work: builds on ENG-1197 (subnet affinity tagging) and ENG-2589 (endpoint lifecycle hooks). Risks: cross-account IAM role propagation requires operator IAM permissions; documented preflight checks fail early if missing. This PR is intentionally conservative about automatic commit to avoid accidental DNS flip. Commits summary and changed files are provided below.
